subject: general
question: **Select the sentence which has no spelling error.**

options.text: Playing and eating are the two prime works during vecation.
Ooty is my dream vacashun spot.
Geeta is going to Pune for vakation.
Children welcome summer vacation with zeal.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Children welcome summer vacation with zeal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error here lies in the spelling of "**vacation**"

 
 
• In option 1 it is written as "**vecation**"
 
• In option 2 it is written as "**vacashun**"
 
• In option 3 it is written as "**vakation**"
 
• In option 4 it is written as "**vacation**" which is the correct spelling.
 
 
 
• **Vacation **means a time when someone does not go to work or school but is free to do what they want, such as travel or relax. (एक समय जब कोई काम या स्कूल नहीं जाता है, लेकिन वह जो चाहे करने के लिए स्वतंत्र होता है, जैसे कि यात्रा करना या आराम करना)

From here we can easily conclude that the sentence written in the option number 4 has no spelling error.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
